user.title: Country
user.description: Public holidays and school holidays depend on the country. Choose where the household lives.

data_description.country: Public holidays come from this country; school holidays too, if the OpenHolidays API covers it.

data_description.subdivision: Regional public holidays and school holidays apply only here. Leave empty for nationwide holidays only.
data_description.weekend: Days off for everyone, every week.
data_description.add_holidays: One per line: a date (YYYY-MM-DD), optionally followed by a name, e.g. “2026-12-24 Christmas Eve”.
data_description.remove_holidays: One per line: a date (YYYY-MM-DD) or part of a holiday name, e.g. “Corpus Christi”.

school_holidays.title: School holidays
school_holidays.description: Residents with the role “pupil” have school holidays off. Choose where the dates come from. OpenHolidays data is licensed under ODbL 1.0 (openholidaysapi.org).

data_description.school_holiday_source: OpenHolidays covers most of Europe and needs no account. A calendar uses its all-day events as school holidays.
data_description.calendar_entity: Only for the source “calendar”: every all-day event counts as a school holiday.

house.title: House
house.description: Besides every resident and room, the whole house gets a morning and an evening mode. Choose whose days count for it and how they are combined.

data.house_roles: Roles that count for the house

data_description.house_roles: Usually the adults: pupils would otherwise switch the house to “day off” for the whole summer.
data_description.house_morning_rule: “Day off wins”: the house sleeps in as soon as one resident is off. “Workday wins”: it is a workday as soon as one resident works.
data_description.house_evening_rule: Refers to tomorrow: “Workday wins” means an evening before a workday as soon as one resident works tomorrow.

access.title: Who may change days
access.description: Days off, roles and rooms can be changed on the dashboard. Automations and scripts are never restricted.

data.admin_only: Only administrators may change days, roles and rooms

data_description.admin_only: Off: every user of this Home Assistant may edit. On: only users with administrator rights.

error.cannot_connect: The OpenHolidays API could not be reached. Check the internet connection or choose another source.
error.not_covered: The OpenHolidays API has no school holidays for this country or region. Choose a calendar or “none”.
error.holiday_format: Use YYYY-MM-DD, optionally followed by a name.

resident.title: Resident
resident.description: A person becomes a resident with a role. Pupils have school holidays off. Personal days off every week replace the household weekend for this person (part-time).

data_description.person: Any person of this Home Assistant.
data_description.role: “None” ends residency from the date on.
data_description.short_name: One or two characters for the calendar card; proposed from the name if empty.
data_description.off_weekdays: Leave empty to use the household weekend.
data_description.valid_from: Earlier days keep what they had; today if empty.

room.title: Room
room.description: A room is an area with residents. Its morning and evening modes combine their days.

data_description.person: Only residents (persons with a role) count.
data_description.morning_rule: “Day off wins”: the room sleeps in as soon as one resident is off.

house.title: Residents of the house
house.description: Whose days count for the whole house. Leave the list empty to count everyone with one of the house roles.

data_description.person: Empty: everyone with a house role (see settings).

options.none: None — pupils have no school holidays

options.day_off_wins: Day off wins — one resident off is enough
options.workday_wins: Workday wins — one resident working is enough

set_days.name: Set days
set_days.description: Marks days as day off or workday for one or more persons, or removes such exceptions. Applies to every day in the range, weekends included.

end.name: Last day
end.description: Last day of the range; same as the first day if omitted.

status.name: Status
status.description: Day off, workday, or default to remove exceptions.

set_role.name: Set role
set_role.description: Makes a person a resident, or changes the role from a date on. Earlier days keep the role they had.

role.name: Role
role.description: Pupil, adult, or none to end residency.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: First day the role applies; today if omitted.

short_name.name: Short name
short_name.description: One or two characters shown in the calendar card.

remove_role.name: Remove role entry
remove_role.description: Removes a role entry that was made by mistake.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: The date of the entry to remove.

set_room.name: Assign room
set_room.description: Sets the residents of a room (an area) from a date on, and/or its morning and evening rules.

person.name: Residents
person.description: Persons living in this room from the date on.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: First day the assignment applies; today if omitted.

morning_rule.name: Morning rule
morning_rule.description: How residents are combined in the morning.

evening_rule.name: Evening rule
evening_rule.description: How residents are combined in the evening.

remove_room_assignment.name: Remove room entry
remove_room_assignment.description: Removes a room assignment entry that was made by mistake.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: The date of the entry to remove.

set_order.name: Set order
set_order.description: Sets the order of residents in the calendar card.

get_days.name: Get days
get_days.description: Returns the day of every resident for whole weeks, with default, exception and reason.

start.name: Start
start.description: Any day of the first week; today if omitted.

preview_days.name: Preview days
preview_days.description: Returns how many days per person would change; writes nothing.

status.name: Status
status.description: The status that would be set.

get_overview.name: Get overview
get_overview.description: Returns all persons and areas with their roles, assignments and the state of the school holiday source.

set_weekly.name: Set weekly days off
set_weekly.description: Personal days off every week for a person from a date on, replacing the household weekend (part-time, four-day week).

weekdays.name: Days off
weekdays.description: Weekdays that are off every week.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: First day the pattern applies; today if omitted.

household.name: Back to household weekend
household.description: Removes the personal pattern; the household weekend applies again.

set_house.name: Set residents of the house
set_house.description: Which residents count for the house from a date on. Without persons (or with “by role”) everyone with a house role counts again.

person.name: Residents
person.description: Residents that count for the house.

valid_from.name: Valid from
valid_from.description: First day the assignment applies; today if omitted.

by_role.name: By role
by_role.description: Back to the default: everyone with a house role.

not_loaded.message: Werktags is not set up yet.

admin_only.message: Only administrators may change Werktags data.

end_before_start.message: The last day lies before the first day.

no_source.message: No school holiday source is configured.

short_name_length.message: The short name must have one or two characters.

short_name_taken.message: The short name “{short_name}” is already used by another resident.

no_role_entry.message: There is no role entry on that date.

last_role_entry.message: The last role entry cannot be removed. Set the role “none” to end residency.

not_resident.message: This person is not a resident yet. Give the person a role first.

not_residents.message: Not residents: {persons}. Give them a role first.

no_room_assignment.message: There is no room assignment on that date.

store_unreadable.message: The stored Werktags data cannot be read: {error}

country_unsupported.message: The country or region is not supported: {error}

school_holidays_unreachable.title: School holidays could not be fetched
school_holidays_unreachable.description: The source “{source}” failed {failures} times in a row. The last known school holidays are still used. Check the connection or choose another source in the options.

school_holidays_incomplete.title: School holidays for {year} are missing
school_holidays_incomplete.description: School holidays are known until {known_to}. Days without data count as workdays for pupils. The source may not have published next year yet; try again later or add the dates as exceptions.

person_missing.title: Residents without a person
person_missing.description: These residents refer to persons that no longer exist in Home Assistant: {ids}. Their sensors are unavailable. Set their role to “none” or recreate the person.

area_missing.title: Rooms without an area
area_missing.description: These rooms refer to areas that no longer exist in Home Assistant: {ids}. Their sensors are unavailable.
